title: Scope audit: observed 2024 member areas and separate historical Sudan source identity

source.observation_kind: reconciled annual bilateral merchandise trade estimates
source.value_unit: thousands of nominal USD; USD columns multiply by exactly 1000
source.decimal_serialization: Exact DECIMAL results are serialized as JSON strings.

queries.observed_2024_scope:
WITH endpoint_areas AS (
 SELECT exporter_code AS country_code,exporter_scope_status AS scope_status,
   exporter_current_member AS current_member
 FROM read_parquet('data/flows/year=2024/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false)
 WHERE exporter_in_scope
 UNION ALL
 SELECT importer_code,importer_scope_status,importer_current_member
 FROM read_parquet('data/flows/year=2024/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false)
 WHERE importer_in_scope
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT country_code) AS observed_in_scope_source_areas,
 count(DISTINCT country_code) FILTER(WHERE current_member) AS observed_modern_member_areas,
 count(DISTINCT country_code) FILTER(WHERE scope_status='historical_predecessor') AS observed_historical_predecessor_areas
FROM endpoint_areas;
queries.sudan_source_area_history:
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT y.year,c.country_code,d.direction
 FROM (VALUES (2010),(2012),(2024)) y(year)
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES (729),(736)) c(country_code)
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('import'),('export')) d(direction)
), observed AS (
 SELECT year,country_code,direction,min(country_name) AS source_country_name,
   min(country_scope_status) AS scope_status,min(country_iso3) AS source_iso3,
   count(*) AS observed_product_markets,sum(observed_partner_count) AS observed_bilateral_rows,
   sum(total_value_1000usd) AS recorded_value_1000usd
 FROM read_parquet('data/exposures/year=*/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false)
 WHERE year IN(2010,2012,2024) AND country_code IN(729,736)
 GROUP BY year,country_code,direction
)
SELECT r.year,r.country_code,r.direction,o.source_country_name,o.scope_status,o.source_iso3,
 o.observed_product_markets IS NOT NULL AS observed_area_direction,
 coalesce(o.observed_product_markets,0) AS observed_product_market_rows,
 coalesce(o.observed_bilateral_rows,0) AS observed_bilateral_row_count,
 o.recorded_value_1000usd
FROM requested r LEFT JOIN observed o USING(year,country_code,direction)
ORDER BY r.year,r.country_code,r.direction;

interpretation_limits: Zero row counts mean no recorded market rows in that selected source area/year/direction, not verified zero trade.
BACI 736 is former Sudan including a different historical territory; do not stitch it to modern 729 by ISO3 abbreviation or describe the result as fixed-border growth.
The full curated scope includes 23 source areas across history, not 23 modern countries.
